programs=base/'programs'; programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    # Arrange four rotations of the input in a 2x2 block.
    n = len(grid)
    clockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid[::-1])]
    counterclockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)][::-1]
    half_turn = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    return [list(grid[r]) + clockwise[r] for r in range(n)] + [counterclockwise[r] + half_turn[r] for r in range(n)]
'''
prog.write_text(source)
